name: opencoursedeck
description: OpenCourseDeck learning studio — static app with vendored browser libs

scripts.first-run: npm run vendor && npm run build:release
scripts.build:release: npm run build && npm run build:sw
scripts.release:attest: npm run release:manifest && npm run release:verify && npm run release:sbom && npm run release:verify-sbom
scripts.tauri:build: npm run native:prepare && node scripts/native-cargo.cjs build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release
scripts.tauri:build:locked: npm run native:prepare && node scripts/native-cargo.cjs build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --locked
scripts.native:exe: npm run build:release && npm run tauri:build:locked && node scripts/stage-native-exe.cjs
scripts.tauri:bundle: npm run native:prepare && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
scripts.lint: node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js src scripts tests desktop app.js bridge.js db.js data.js notes.js player.js pdf.js progress.js canvas.js ui.js boot.js eslint.config.js vitest.config.js
scripts.ci: npm run check:encoding && npm run check:workflows && npm run validate && npm run lint && npm run build:release && npm run check:generated && npm run check:font-budget && npm run release:attest && npm test && npm run audit && npm run report:bundle && npm run report:search-index && npm run smoke && npm run smoke:browser && npm run smoke:dist-browser
scripts.tauri:bundle:locked: npm run native:prepare && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.conf.json -- --locked
